wood_laminate.description: Front-facing light laminate plank pattern for floors, worktops and furniture. Several plank rows are present within one image; uv_scale_m is the whole-image repeat size, not the width of one board. Inspect the source/repeat preview when choosing scale.
wood_laminate.calibration: appearance prior; physical reflectance is not measured
wood_laminate.repeat_size_hint_basis: Optional visual starting point for a floor; not a measured source scale.

office_wall.description: Office wall base-color and normal texture for primitives, containers and composite parts
office_wall.normal_convention: source tangent-space encoding; no axis flips applied
office_wall.calibration: appearance prior; physical reflectance is not measured

fabric_grid.description: Square grid fabric pattern for primitives, containers and composite parts
fabric_grid.calibration: appearance prior; physical reflectance is not measured

wood_oak_floor.description: Oblique photograph of stained oak flooring with perspective and baked illumination. Repeating it on a planar floor reproduces the diagonal perspective and visible tile boundaries; wood_laminate provides a front-facing plank pattern.
wood_oak_floor.calibration: appearance prior; physical reflectance is not measured
